provenance.evidence: EquiVM v4.29.0 -> v4.33.1 (lean-mend run 5 residue), Examples.BlindAuction.Bids 143: `simp [bidsAddressKey, hleStorage]` leaves `(if i < s then … else EvalResult.revert) = EvalResult.revert` with `hleStorage : s ≤ i`. simp unfolded `bidsAddressKey` in the condition but not in its `Decidable` instance. At v4.29.0 simp closed the goal by `ite_eq_right_iff`, `imp_false`, `not_lt`, `hleStorage`; at v4.33.1 `ite_eq_right_iff` no longer unifies with the mismatched instance. `← Nat.not_le` rewrites the condition to `¬ s ≤ i` directly, and the hypothesis decides it. In a copy of the real module the error went away, and the simp argument hleStorage is no longer unused. `← Nat.not_lt` is the same repair for a condition `i ≤ s` and a hypothesis `s < i`. At Reasoning.VyperDispatch 338 both candidates make the simp loop (an error inside the edit), so they are rejected; simp-set-pure-unsolved repairs that site.
